pre_command:
osascript -e 'tell application "Contacts"
    set firstName to "Robert"
    set lastName to "Green"
    try
        set matchingPeople to (people whose first name is firstName and last name is lastName)
        if (count of matchingPeople) > 0 then
            repeat with thePerson in matchingPeople
                delete thePerson
            end repeat
            save
        else
        end if
    on error errMsg
    end try
    set thePerson to make new person with properties {first name:firstName, last name:lastName}
    tell thePerson
        make new phone at end of phones with properties {label:"mobile", value:"(555) 123-4567"}
    end tell
    tell thePerson
        make new phone at end of phones with properties {label:"mobile", value:"(555) 987-6543"}
    end tell
    tell thePerson
        make new phone at end of phones with properties {label:"home", value:"(555) 555-1212"}
    end tell
    save
end tell'; osascript -e 'tell application "Contacts" to quit'; sleep 2
instruction: Perform a complex edit on the existing contact 'Robert Green': change their home phone number to '555-789-0123', add a new job title 'Senior Developer', and remove any existing mobile phone number.
evaluator:
osascript -e 'tell application "Contacts" to try
set robertContact to first person whose name is "Robert Green"
set hasCorrectHomePhone to false
set hasJobTitle to false
set hasMobilePhone to false
try
set phoneList to phones of robertContact
repeat with aPhone in phoneList
set phoneLabel to label of aPhone
set phoneValue to value of aPhone
set normalizedPhone to (do shell script "echo " & quoted form of phoneValue & " | tr -d \"() -\"")
if phoneLabel is "home" and normalizedPhone contains "5557890123" then
set hasCorrectHomePhone to true
end if
if phoneLabel is "mobile" or phoneLabel is "iPhone" then
set hasMobilePhone to true
end if
end repeat
end try
try
set jobTitle to job title of robertContact
if jobTitle is "Senior Developer" then
set hasJobTitle to true
end if
on error
end try
if (hasCorrectHomePhone and hasJobTitle and not hasMobilePhone) then
return "True"
else
return "False"
end if
on error
return "False"
end try'
